import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'server' / 'update_config.py'

class UpdateConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_existing_identity_and_credentials_are_preserved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / 'homeserver.yaml'
            original = {'server_name': 'message.hasbreo.com', 'database': {'name': 'psycopg2', 'args': {'password': 'fixture-secret'}}, 'registration_shared_secret': 'fixture-registration', 'signing_key_path': '/data/original.signing.key', 'registration_requires_token': True, 'custom_setting': {'keep': ['all', 'values']}, 'password_policy': {'enabled': True, 'minimum_length': 12}}
            path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(original))
            subprocess.run(['python3', str(SCRIPT), str(path)], check=True, capture_output=True)
            updated = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(updated.pop('password_policy')['minimum_length'], 8)
            expected = dict(original); expected.pop('password_policy')
            self.assertEqual(updated, expected)
            backup = path.with_name('homeserver.pre-0.2.0.yaml')
            self.assertEqual(yaml.safe_load(backup.read_text()), original)
            self.assertEqual(path.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o600)
            subprocess.run(['python3', str(SCRIPT), str(path)], check=True, capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(yaml.safe_load(backup.read_text()), original)

    def test_unrecognised_configuration_is_not_overwritten(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path=Path(directory)/'homeserver.yaml';path.write_text('unexpected: true\n')
            result=subprocess.run(['python3',str(SCRIPT),str(path)],capture_output=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode,0)
            self.assertEqual(path.read_text(),'unexpected: true\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
